item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-03
item.description: Taiwan's hardware giants launch TAIONE foundation to claim open-source AI governance; Chinese AI IPO rush accelerates with DeepSeek and Moonshot; US lead over China in AI disappears; the social costs of AI deployment in China come into focus.
